title: Render DRRs
summary: Projects each CT into 2-D synthetic X-rays (DRRs) by the render blocks: views, detector, rays, preset.
does: The render blocks (src/schwingnet/render_blocks.py) run by tools/flexray_render.py: each CT gives views projections on a detector of detector x detector pixels with ray_samples samples a ray, by FleXray's recipe or one of the presets. Images are 16-bit grey PNGs (65535 is 1), so the dtype is left as it came. With a segmenter's masks each view keeps its levels' projected labels; physical-ct reads no mask and renders pixels alone. Today it runs inside the DRR study's flow on its render groups (data/domain_gap/groups.json), on TotalSegmentator v2.0.1 CTs.

inputs.name: volumes
inputs.what: CT volumes, with masks unless labels is none.

outputs.name: data
outputs.what: 2-D DRRs N x C x detector x detector, with projected level masks unless labels is none.

params.name: detector
params.what: pixels a side of the detector

params.name: labels
params.what: mask: each view keeps the segmenter's levels projected; none: pixels alone

rules.say: physical-ct reads no mask, so its views carry no labels: set labels to none
fluxray-raw renders on a detector of 1024 pixels

nondeterminism: A view's crop and pose come from the salt, the subject and the view alone, so a render repeats them; the GPU's arithmetic may differ in its last bits.

generic.why: It projects CT volumes (tools/flexray_render.py); a 2-D image has nothing to project, and a volume of another modality would need its own attenuation model.

today.note: the word bench flexray_drr_gap renders the study's groups
